stance_target: the claim that a global exact minimum-area hyperbolic 2-orbifold isospectral pair is an established/settled result in the literature
quoted_support: It is not known what the smallest area of a pair of arithmetic hyperbolic 2-orbifolds is, but one may suspect that it is the area of a particularly simple pair of isospectral hyperbolic polygons found by Doyle and Rossetti [DR, Section 2].

claim: The largest volume of an isospectral non-isometric pair of spherical orbifolds of dimension d>=5 is at most (1/8) vol(S^d), an exact bound derived from a Rossetti-Schueth-Weilandt almost-conjugate pair in SO(6), not a near-collision/approximate construction.
stance_target: known exact bounds (as opposed to near-collisions) for spherical orbifold isospectral pairs
quoted_support: Theorem 1.5. The largest volume of an isospectral and non-isometric pair of spherical orbifolds of dimension d ≥ 5 is at most 1/8 vol(S^d).
